paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of preference modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.

annotations.annotation: This line plot illustrates the gradient norm of a preference model across different training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Step" and follows a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1400, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled "Gradient Norm", also utilizing a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 900, with tick intervals of 200. The plot depicts a single line that is blue, with a solid line style and no markers. At the beginning of the x-axis, the line starts with a high gradient norm value of approximately 850, which sharply declines before reaching nearly 0 around 100 on the x-axis. The line remains steady and close to 0 for the remainder of the x-axis, except for minor fluctuations, including a small spike near 550 on the x-axis. There is a legend at the top right of the plot to label the line.
